Raw-to-parsed coverage: the raw eligibility_text has 7 inclusion and 3 exclusion items. The 10 parsed_criteria rows match them one-to-one, with verbatim text. No clause is missing or reordered.
inc_003 combines a sex clause ('Male or female') with an age clause. The trial_record fields (sex=ALL, minimum_age=18 Years, maximum_age=null) are consistent with it.

inc_005 is compound and ambiguous. (a) '≥ 6 months before signing informed consent' could mean at least 6 months of continuous basal insulin use, or use at some point at least 6 months before consent. (b) It embeds an exclusion-like clause: no bolus insulin for 14 days or more within the 90 days before switching to icodec. That clause is anchored to a 'switching' date that is not otherwise defined. It could be split into its own exclusion row.

inc_006 contains an OR alternative: an HbA1c within 90 days before V1, or an HbA1c taken in relation to V1 'if in line with local clinical practice'. Both alternatives depend on a V1 date that is not supplied.

inc_001, inc_002, exc_001, and exc_002 are procedural or administrative (consent, the physician/participant decision to start icodec, prior participation, investigational drug exposure). They are not evaluable from routine EHR facts.
exc_003 groups three separate conditions in one row: mental incapacity, unwillingness, and language barriers.

Several criteria depend on dates that are not supplied: the informed-consent date, the 'Initiation visit' (V1) date, the enrolment date, and the switch-to-icodec date. The reference_date (2021-11-30) is used only as a hypothetical anchor and is not substituted for these dates.

Temporal gap: the latest patient facts are dated 2020-12-28, the reference_date is 2021-11-30, and the trial started 2026-07-02 (snapshot 2026-10-11). No statement about current trial eligibility is made.

Patient-data coverage: CarePlan, CareTeam, Claim, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, ExplanationOfBenefit, Immunization, and Provenance resources were not processed into patient_facts (see warnings). They may contain information relevant to diabetes type and medication history.

Patient-data inconsistency: the condition coded SNOMED 44054006 has the display text 'Diabetes' with no type stated. A 'Prediabetes' condition (SNOMED 15777000) is recorded as active with onset 2018-12-17, after the diabetes onset of 2017-12-11, and both carry raw status 'active'. This weakens confidence in diabetes type and status.

Language context: the sites are all in China and the patient's PRAPARE preferred language is English. Whether that is a language barrier depends on study materials and site capability, which are not specified in the source.

criteria.criterion_text: Signed consent obtained before any study-related activities (study-related activities are any procedure related to recording of data according to protocol).
criteria.reasoning: This is a study-procedural requirement. The patient facts contain no record of informed consent for this study.
criteria.missing_information: ["Documentation of signed informed consent for NCT07658417 and its date relative to study-related activities"]

criteria.criterion_text: The decision to initiate treatment with commercially available insulin icodec has been made by the participant/Legally Acceptable Representative (LAR) and the treating physician before and independently from the decision to include participant in this study.
criteria.reasoning: There is no record of insulin icodec, of a prescribing decision, or of a treating-physician decision. The only medication requests in the file are for metformin.
criteria.missing_information: ["Record of a clinical decision to start commercially available insulin icodec", "Date of that decision relative to the study-inclusion decision"]

criteria.criterion_text: Male or female, age above or equal to 18 years at the time of signing informed consent.
criteria.reasoning: The Patient resource records gender 'male' and birth_date 1977-12-05, which satisfies the sex clause. The consent date is not supplied. However, the patient turned 18 on 1995-12-05, so he is 18 or older on any consent date from then on, and consent for this study could not predate the study (start_date 2026-07-02). Age at the hypothetical reference date (2021-11-30) is recorded as 43. No deceased_date is recorded. This is not a statement of current eligibility.
criteria.missing_information: ["Actual informed-consent date (not needed to establish the age threshold, but needed to document it)"]

criteria.criterion_text: Diagnosed with T2D greater than or equal to (≥) 1 year before signing informed consent.
criteria.reasoning: A Condition is recorded with SNOMED CT code 44054006, display 'Diabetes', onset and recorded 2017-12-11, clinical status 'active', and verification 'confirmed'. Outside the file, SNOMED CT names 44054006 as type 2 diabetes mellitus. Inside the file, however, the display text does not state the type. An active 'Prediabetes' condition (SNOMED 15777000) is also recorded with onset 2018-12-17, after the diabetes onset, which is internally inconsistent. HbA1c results (LOINC 4548-4) were 7.56 % on 2017-12-11, 6.06 % on 2018-12-17, 5.47 % on 2019-12-23, and 5.62 % on 2020-12-28; these are reported without applying a diagnostic threshold. Timing is not the barrier: an onset of 2017-12-11 is at least 1 year before any consent on or after 2018-12-11. The diabetes type is the unresolved issue. The metformin prescriptions were not used to infer the diagnosis.
criteria.missing_information: ["Explicit confirmation that the recorded diabetes diagnosis is type 2 (resolve the 'Diabetes' display versus code meaning, and the coexisting active prediabetes record)", "Informed-consent date"]

criteria.criterion_text: Treated with once- or twice-daily basal insulin injections ≥ 6 months before signing informed consent. Any other antidiabetic medications are allowed, except for bolus insulin during the 90 days prior to switching to icodec for a period of 14 days or more.
criteria.reasoning: The only medication records are five MedicationRequests for RxNorm 860975 (24 HR metformin hydrochloride 500 MG extended-release oral tablet). They were authored on 2017-12-11 (two), 2018-12-17, 2019-12-23, and 2020-12-28; the last has raw status 'active' and the others 'stopped'. These are prescriptions, not proof of use. No basal or bolus insulin record appears. That absence does not prove the patient never received basal insulin, so it is not a contradiction and NOT_MET is not justified. The consent and switch dates are not supplied, and no medication facts exist after 2020-12-28.
criteria.missing_information: ["Any record of once- or twice-daily basal insulin, with start date and duration", "Informed-consent date", "Bolus insulin exposure in the 90 days before the icodec switch, and the switch date", "Dispensing or administration records"]

criteria.criterion_text: Available glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) within 90 days prior to the 'Initiation visit' (V1) or HbA1c measurement taken in relation with the 'Initiation visit' (V1) if in line with local clinical practice.
criteria.reasoning: HbA1c observations (LOINC 4548-4, unit %) exist dated 2017-12-11 (7.56), 2018-12-17 (6.06), 2019-12-23 (5.47), and 2020-12-28 (5.62). The V1 date is not supplied, so the 90-day window cannot be evaluated. Per instructions, the reference_date is not used as a substitute for V1. For context only, the latest HbA1c (2020-12-28) is 337 days before the hypothetical reference date. Whether an HbA1c is taken at V1 cannot be known from these records.
criteria.missing_information: ["Date of the 'Initiation visit' (V1)", "HbA1c within 90 days before V1, or one taken in relation to V1"]

criteria.criterion_text: Treatment-naïve to once-weekly insulin prior to the 'Initiation Visit' (V1)
criteria.reasoning: No once-weekly insulin record appears in the supplied medication facts, which contain metformin requests only, the last authored 2020-12-28. A missing record does not prove absence of exposure. The facts also do not cover the period up to a V1 date, which is not supplied. Naïve status therefore cannot be affirmed.
criteria.missing_information: ["Complete medication history up to V1, including any once-weekly insulin exposure", "Date of V1"]

criteria.criterion_text: Previous participation in this study. Participation is defined as having given informed consent in this study.
criteria.reasoning: There is no record of research participation or consent for this study. Absence of a record is not affirmative evidence that the exclusion is false. The patient facts end 2020-12-28, before the study start date (2026-07-02), so they cannot address participation after that date.
criteria.missing_information: ["Study enrolment or consent registry check for NCT07658417"]

criteria.criterion_text: Treatment with any investigational drug within 30 days prior to enrolment into study.
criteria.reasoning: The enrolment date is not supplied, and there are no medication or research records near any plausible enrolment date. The supplied medication facts end 2020-12-28. No investigational drug is recorded, but that absence does not affirmatively show the exclusion is false.
criteria.missing_information: ["Enrolment date", "Medication and research-participation history for the 30 days before enrolment"]

criteria.criterion_text: Mental incapacity, unwillingness or language barriers precluding adequate understanding or cooperation.
criteria.reasoning: In PRAPARE observations (LOINC 93025-5) from 2012-02-20 through 2020-12-28, the preferred-language component (LOINC 54899-0) is 'English' each time. All listed study sites are in China. Whether this creates a language barrier depends on study materials and site staff, which are not described. No mental-incapacity condition is recorded. A PHQ-9 total score of 20 is recorded on 2020-12-28 (LOINC 44261-6); a screening score does not by itself establish or exclude incapacity. Willingness to cooperate is not documented. Neither the presence nor the absence of the exclusion can be established.
criteria.missing_information: ["Assessment of decision-making capacity at screening", "Willingness to participate", "Language of study materials and site staff relative to the patient's language abilities"]
